question_text: The Government Procurement Reform Act (RA 9184) aims to promote transparency, competitiveness, and efficiency in public procurement. It requires all government agencies to conduct public bidding for contracts above a certain threshold. The law also establishes the Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) to oversee implementation. Critics argue that despite the law, corruption persists due to loopholes such as unjustified single-source procurement and bid rigging. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: The GPPB has been ineffective in stopping corruption.
Loopholes in RA 9184 are being exploited by corrupt individuals.
The law has no positive impact on procurement.
